name: Balticon
blurb: Maryland's science fiction & fantasy convention since 1967, with 300+ hours of programming, an art show, masquerade and gaming in Baltimore's Inner Harbor.

picks: The Book of Lost Hours; 2026 Compton Crook winner
Music Guest of Honor; Portland pop-folk trio

editions.evidence: Homepage + hotel page text: "BALTICON 61 MAY 28 - 31, 2027"; "Balticon will once again be at the Renaissance Baltimore Harborplace Hotel ... 202 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, MD 21202"

notes: The 2027 Guest of Honor, Robert A. Heinlein Award recipient, Compton Crook Winner and one Special Guest slot are all still teased as "Guess Who?" (hidden, with a reveal-later photo placeholder) on the official Guests of Honor page, so those are excluded as not yet announced; only the two already-named guests (the Music Guest of Honor and the 2026 Compton Crook winner invited as a special guest) are recorded. An aggregator site gave different dates (May 21-24, 2027); the official site's own text (May 28-31, 2027) was used instead per the research rules. Verify-05 recheck (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- a fresh extraction shows the same two named cards, each explicitly tagged '2027 Music Guest of Honor' and the 2027 special-guest slot for the '2026 Compton Crook Winner', with every other GoH slot still hidden behind 'Guess Who? 2027 ...'. Refute attempt (2026-10-05): upheld (proof) -- fresh re-extraction confirms The PDX Broadsides' own card is still tagged '2027 Music Guest of Honor' and sits among four other 'Guess Who? 2027 ...' placeholder slots (two still hidden), showing this is an in-progress reveal built for Balticon 61 specifically, not a finished page left over from Balticon 60.
